data.name: Field & Sky
data.detailed_description:
Field & Sky

In Field & Sky, you inherit a piece of family land on the edge of a quiet rural frontier and set out to build a functioning modern homestead. Starting with open fields and access to a nearby town, you grow crops, raise livestock, and develop the infrastructure needed to support a self-sustaining rural life. Expand outward from the road, connect to the town’s power and water grid, and watch your land transform from empty terrain into a thriving property. Play at your own pace in a realistic open world, switching between a strategic top-down view and an immersive street-view-style perspective to explore the homestead you’re building.

Features

🏡 Homestead Building – Design and expand your property with farms, orchards, livestock operations, workshops, storage, and modern infrastructure.

🌱 Farming & Livestock – Grow a wide variety of crops and raise animals such as cattle, chickens, pigs, vineyards, and orchards, each with realistic layouts and progression.

🏙️ Town Connection – Stay linked to a nearby town that supplies power, water, logistics, and services, creating a living relationship between your land and the world beyond it.

🛒 In-Game Internet & Ordering – Purchase tools, equipment, furniture, and upgrades through a mock in-game online system and have them delivered to your homestead.

🎥 Dual View Exploration – Build from a top-down perspective, then drop into a street-view-style camera to explore your land at ground level. (Coming Soon!)

🌄 Open-World Atmosphere – Experience a detailed, realistic environment with dynamic lighting, weather, and a calm, immersive rural setting.

⚙️ Optional Survival Mode – Enable survival mechanics such as hunger, thirst, and fatigue for a deeper challenge, or play without pressure in relaxed mode. (Coming Soon!)

♾️ Open-Ended Progression – There is no fixed end state; continue expanding, refining, and personalizing your homestead over time.

🎨 Future Expansions – Optional DLC packs will introduce new crops, animals, building types, regions, and gameplay systems.
